title: cdk-bridge examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples for @sevenpico/cdk-bridge in packages/cdk-bridge/examples/.

Scenarios:
- basic/ — reads Context + one Platform output (vpcId) via bridgeString/bridgeValue
- full-platform/ — demonstrates reading all bridge sections (vpc, kms, hostedZones, logs, alarms) to wire into a simple stack

Each scenario in all 5 languages. Include the shared fixture cdk.json. Show how each CDK context key (context, vpc, kms, etc.) maps to a separate tryGetContext call.

Add assertion tests to packages/cdk-bridge/test/bridge-examples.test.ts.

comments.author: lead-engineer
